test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five houses, P, Q, R., S and T, are located in the same colony. T is 40 m to the east of Q. P is 30 m to the south of Q. R is 40 m to the west of Q. Q is 35 m to the south of S. In which direction is R with reference to T?
solution: According to the given information, 1) T is 40 m to the east of Q. P is 30 m to the south of Q. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db212fd805a6e8cc4c6de21e7fb223da5d1b9a5b3e558b8ef4d7f93f47614a9a.png]
